verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken banner. The full-bleed geometric background and white card are reduced to a small square tile in the middle. The white frame becomes a tiny empty box with the two pink dots floating to the right. The opening date is tiny and pushed far left, away from the headline. 'DEAN COOPER' and 'THE MINIMALIST' are split apart, and there is dead white space on the left. In A, 'PRESENTS' runs into the pattern tile, a clear collision. In B the line is pulled back so it only touches the tile's edge, which makes B slightly less bad.
